params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ahri''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Essence Fragment'' whenever she kills a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}. At 9 stacks, she consumes them to {{tip|heal}} herself for {{pplevel|35 to 95|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}.
params.description2: Additionally, whenever '''Ahri''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them, she consumes their essence to heal herself for {{pplevel|75 to 165|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}.

description2.plain: Additionally, whenever Ahri scores a champion takedown within 3 seconds of damaging them, she consumes their essence to heal herself for 75 – 165 (based on level) (+ 30% AP).

blurb.plain: Innate: Ahri generates a stack of Essence Fragment from killing minions and monsters. At max stacks, she consumes them to heal herself.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ahri''' sends her orb in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through. Upon reaching maximum range, it returns to her to deal the same amount in {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} to enemies it passes through.
params.leveling: {{st|Damage Per Pass|{{ap|35 to 135}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Total Mixed Damage|{{ap|35*2 to 135*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% AP)}}}}
params.description2: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''
params.notes:
* ''Orb of Deception'' will hit additional units around the return point in a small circle when the orb turns around.
** This applies both to the initial and return missile's respective areas of effect (though the initial missile only registers a hit around the return point if the unit was not hit by it already, since it can only register once per pass).
* If '''Ahri''' dies while the orb is out, the orb will visually disappear but continue to deal damage and return to '''Ahri'''.{{bug}}<!-- Was this fixed with 13.19? note was added long before that -->

params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ahri''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location and then fires essence bolts to up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, each dealing {{as|magic damage}}.

''Spirit Rush'' can be recast twice more within 15 seconds of the activation at no additional cost, with a 1-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. Consuming a champion's essence with ''{{ai|Essence Theft|Ahri}}'' while ''Spirit Rush'' is active extends the recast duration by and up to 10 seconds, and grants an additional recast, storing up to 3 recasts at a time.
params.description3: ''Spirit Rush's recast duration will persist even after using all recasts. {{ai|Fox-Fire|Ahri}} can be cast during the dash.''
params.target range: {{tt|500|Maximum dash distance}}<!--has a minimum dash range, needs to be measured-->
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|600|Bolt search radius around Ahri's destination}}
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|1200 + {{as|100% movement speed|movement speed}}|Dash speed}}|{{tt|1400|Energy bolt missile speed}}}}
params.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|140 to 100}}|Starts after first cast, and refreshes upon gaining recasts}}
params.notes:
{{always quickcast}}
* Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* There exists a slight delay before a champion gains vision of the fog of war once inside it. Because of this, if '''Ahri''' dashes into it, it is possible that ''Spirit Rush'' will not target any enemy in range.
* The bolts do not fire if '''Ahri''' dies while {{tip|dash|dashing}}.
** The bolts will fire if the dash is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by other means, including by entering {{tip|resurrection}}.
